<?php
/**
 * Kubernetes Background Job Worker
 * Processes template rendering jobs from Redis queue
 * Deployed as a CronJob in k8s namespace: batch-processing
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Worker;

use Redis;
use Monolog\Logger;
use Monolog\Handler\StreamHandler;

class TemplateRenderWorker
{
    private Redis $redis;
    private Logger $logger;
    private string $outputDir;
    private array $allowedDirectives;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->redis = new Redis();
        $this->redis->connect(
            getenv('REDIS_HOST') ?: 'redis-service.batch-processing.svc.cluster.local',
            (int)(getenv('REDIS_PORT') ?: 6379)
        );
        
        $this->logger = new Logger('worker');
        $this->logger->pushHandler(new StreamHandler('/var/log/worker/jobs.log'));
        
        $this->outputDir = getenv('OUTPUT_DIR') ?: '/srv/www/reports';
        $this->allowedDirectives = ['include', 'echo', 'set'];
    }

    /**
     * Sanitize SSI directives - remove dangerous exec/cmd directives
     */
    private function sanitizeSSIDirectives(string $content): string
    {
        // Remove exec directives which could run arbitrary commands
        $content = preg_replace(
            '/<!--\s*#\s*exec\s+[^>]*-->/',
            '<!-- directive removed -->',
            $content
        );
        
        // Remove fsize and flastmod that could leak info
        $content = preg_replace(
            '/<!--\s*#\s*(fsize|flastmod)\s+[^>]*-->/',
            '<!-- directive removed -->',
            $content
        );
        
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * Validate that file paths in include directives are safe
     */
    private function validateIncludePaths(string $content): string
    {
        // Normalize path traversal attempts in include directives
        $content = preg_replace_callback(
            '/<!--\s*#\s*include\s+(virtual|file)="([^"]+)"\s*-->/',
            function ($matches) {
                $type = $matches[1];
                $path = $matches[2];
                
                // Block path traversal
                if (strpos($path, '..') !== false) {
                    return '<!-- blocked: path traversal -->';
                }
                
                // Only allow .html and .txt includes
                $ext = pathinfo($path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
                if (!in_array($ext, ['html', 'txt', 'htm'], true)) {
                    return '<!-- blocked: invalid extension -->';
                }
                
                return $matches[0];
            },
            $content
        );
        
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * Process template variables - replaces {{var}} with values from job data
     */
    private function processVariables(string $content, array $variables): string
    {
        foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
            if (!is_string($value)) {
                continue;
            }
            // Only allow alphanumeric variable names
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/', $key)) {
                continue;
            }
            $content = str_replace('{{' . $key . '}}', $value, $content);
        }
        return $content;
    }

    /**
     * Encode content for safe output - handles the final encoding pass
     */
    private function encodeForOutput(string $content, string $encoding): string
    {
        if ($encoding === 'raw') {
            return $content;
        }
        
        // For HTML output, encode entities but preserve allowed SSI directives
        if ($encoding === 'ssi-passthrough') {
            // Temporarily replace valid SSI with placeholders
            $placeholders = [];
            $content = preg_replace_callback(
                '/<!--\s*#\s*(include|echo|set)\s+[^>]*-->/',
                function ($match) use (&$placeholders) {
                    $key = '___SSI_' . count($placeholders) . '___';
                    $placeholders[$key] = $match[0];
                    return $key;
                },
                $content
            );
            
            $content = htmlspecialchars($content, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
            
            // Restore SSI directives
            foreach ($placeholders as $key => $directive) {
                $content = str_replace(
                    htmlspecialchars($key, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
                    $directive,
                    $content
                );
            }
            
            return $content;
        }
        
        return htmlspecialchars($content, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }

    /**
     * Main job processing pipeline
     */
    public function processJob(array $job): bool
    {
        $this->logger->info('Processing job', ['id' => $job['id'] ?? 'unknown']);
        
        $template = $job['template'] ?? '';
        $variables = $job['variables'] ?? [];
        $outputFile = basename($job['output_file'] ?? 'output.html');
        $encoding = $job['encoding'] ?? 'html';
        
        // Step 1: Sanitize SSI directives in template
        $content = $this->sanitizeSSIDirectives($template);
        
        // Step 2: Validate include paths
        $content = $this->validateIncludePaths($content);
        
        // Step 3: Process template variables
        $content = $this->processVariables($content, $variables);
        
        // Step 4: Apply output encoding
        $content = $this->encodeForOutput($content, $encoding);
        
        // Step 5: Write to output directory (served by Apache with SSI enabled)
        $outputPath = $this->outputDir . '/' . $outputFile;
        
        if (file_put_contents($outputPath, $content) === false) {
            $this->logger->error('Failed to write output', ['path' => $outputPath]);
            return false;
        }
        
        $this->logger->info('Job completed', ['output' => $outputPath]);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Worker loop - polls Redis for jobs
     */
    public function run(): void
    {
        $this->logger->info('Worker started');
        
        while (true) {
            $rawJob = $this->redis->brPop(['template_jobs'], 30);
            
            if ($rawJob === null || $rawJob === false) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $job = json_decode($rawJob[1], true);
            
            if (!is_array($job)) {
                $this->logger->warning('Invalid job format');
                continue;
            }
            
            try {
                $this->processJob($job);
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $this->logger->error('Job failed', [
                    'error' => $e->getMessage(),
                    'job_id' => $job['id'] ?? 'unknown'
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Entry point
$worker = new TemplateRenderWorker();
$worker->run();
